meta_description:
2,463 likes, 79 comments - drmarkhyman on October 27, 2026: "A year and a half ago, I almost died. After back surgery, I’d lost 25 pounds and was in a wheelchair. I couldn’t walk without someone holding me up or using a walker.

I was exhausted. I was depressed. And I had to start from zero.

I didn’t feel like rebuilding my strength. I wanted to stay in bed and numb out. But with help from my physical therapist, I started with what I could manage: lying on the floor with a small resistance band around my knees, doing a few repetitions.

That was it. That was my starting point.

Then I did it again the next day.

I wanted my life back, but that didn’t mean I woke up feeling motivated to do the work. Most days, I didn’t.

If you’re starting over, I know how discouraging it can feel to remember what you used to be able to do. Start with what’s possible for you today. Let that count.".
